notes: Wattle Notes 0.1.11 developer alpha. Allows notebook deletion during Drive sync: choose Delete after sync, cancel while waiting, and safely delete once the current pass ends. New automatic sync passes yield to the confirmed deletion; pending edits save first, and stale workspace requests are rejected. Retains the verified macOS bundle signature and dependency security fixes. Google sign-in is built in; users can connect without creating or importing an OAuth client. Keeps existing notebook configuration and notes. Mostly vibe coded with AI assistance. Mac build remains unsigned by Apple and not notarized.
